title: ELOVL6: A Key Factor in the Gender Differences of Olanzapine-Induced Weight Gain.
authors: Che, Keke; Li, Dejuan; Liu, Lu; Zhang, Yanyan; Liu, Xuemei; Hu, Changhua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究奥氮平通过HNF-3alpha调控ELOVL6表达致雌性体重增加，虽涉及转录因子-DNA结合与分子对接，但核心是代谢表型而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: Background: This study investigates the role of ELOVL6 in the weight gain induced by olanzapine and the mechanisms underlying the female-specific response. Methods: An olanzapine-induced weight gain model in SD rats was developed. Transcriptome sequencing and metabolomics identified genes and metabolites linked to female-specific weight gain. Validation was conducted in HL7702 cells, and DNA pulldown, ChIP-qPCR, and molecular docking explored the molecular mechanism. A genetic polymorphism association study was also performed. Results: Female rats showed more pronounced weight gain compared to males following olanzapine treatment. Transcriptomic and metabolomics analyses revealed that olanzapine significantly upregulates hepatic ELOVL6 expression and long-chain fatty acid synthesis in females. Inhibition of ELOVL6 restores the elevated levels of the lipid, SREBP-1c and FAS induced by olanzapine. The transcription factor HNF-3alpha is implicated in ELOVL6 regulation, and some olanzapine metabolites can directly interact with HNF-3alpha. Furthermore, a single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) at the ELOVL6 promoter -1427 bp correlates with weight gain in female patients. Conclusions: Olanzapine metabolites interact with HNF-3alpha, enhancing ELOVL6 transcription. The upregulated ELOVL6 promotes long-chain fatty acid synthesis via the SREBP-1c/FAS pathway, contributing to female-specific weight gain.
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究探讨ELOVL6在奥氮平诱导的体重增加中的作用及女性特异性反应背后的机制。方法：建立了SD大鼠奥氮平诱导的体重增加模型。转录组测序和代谢组学鉴定了与女性特异性体重增加相关的基因和代谢物。在HL7702细胞中进行了验证，并通过DNA下拉、ChIP-qPCR和分子对接探索了分子机制。还进行了遗传多态性关联研究。结果：奥氮平治疗后，雌性大鼠的体重增加比雄性更显著。转录组和代谢组学分析显示，奥氮平显著上调雌性肝脏中ELOVL6表达和长链脂肪酸合成。抑制ELOVL6可恢复奥氮平诱导的脂质、SREBP-1c和FAS水平升高。转录因子HNF-3alpha参与ELOVL6的调控，且一些奥氮平代谢物可直接与HNF-3alpha相互作用。此外，ELOVL6启动子-1427 bp处的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与女性患者的体重增加相关。结论：奥氮平代谢物与HNF-3alpha相互作用，增强ELOVL6转录。上调的ELOVL6通过SREBP-1c/FAS途径促进长链脂肪酸合成，从而促成女性特异性体重增加。
